title_sq: Tek Forest Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri dhe Orientim Perfekt !!!
description_sq: Tek Forest Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1, me Planimetri dhe Orientim Perfekt !!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 2 banim dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 119 m2, nga ku siperfaqja neto eshte 105 m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma e matrimoniale me tualet te dedikuar, dhoma e femijeve, tualeti qendror dhe nje ballkon. Orientimi i prones eshte lindje. Vetem 15 minuta nga qendra e Tiranes, pozicioni i kompleksit mundeson akses te drejtperdrejte ndaj sherbimeve si: shkolla, spitale, qendra tregtare, transport urban, etj. Per kete projekt eshte konceptuar nje zone perimetrale e gjelberuar dhe rekreative prej 8000m². Projektimi i qendrueshem eshte nje nder pikat e forta te zhvillimit te ketij kompleksi, duke perdorur teknologji bashkekohore dhe standarde europiane me aplikimin e fasades dhe vetratave termike. Aktualisht godina eshte ne fazen e ndarjes me tulle .
title_en: At Forest Residence, 2+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!!!
description_en: At Forest Residence, 2+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!!! The property is located on the 2nd residential floor and has a gross area of ​​119 m2, of which the net area is 105 m2. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, the matrimonial room with a dedicated toilet, the children's room, the central toilet and a balcony. The orientation of the property is east. Only 15 minutes from the center of Tirana, the location of the complex allows direct access to services such as: schools, hospitals, shopping centers, urban transport, etc. A green and recreational perimeter area of ​​8000m² has been conceived for this project. The sustainable design is one of the strong points of the development of this complex, using contemporary technology and European standards with the application of the facade and thermal windows. Currently, the building is in the stage of partition with bricks.
